sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First, let me move the green at (44, 31) back to the right so it's not stuck
result = action(['RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        greens[n['hash']] = center
print("After 5 RIGHT:", greens)

# Now try clicking on the frame at (44, 8)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 44, 'col': 8}])
print(f"\nClicked frame (44,8): board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        children_colors = []
        for cid in n.get('children', []):
            for cn in seg['nodes']:
                if cn['id'] == cid:
                    children_colors.append((cn['color'], cn['pixels']))
        greens[n['hash']] = (center, n['pixels'], children_colors)
print("Greens:", greens)

print("\nFrame interiors:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'c' and n['children']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        child_id = n['children'][0]
        child = None
        for cn in seg['nodes']:
            if cn['id'] == child_id:
                child = cn
                break
        if child:
            print(f"  Frame at {center}: child={child['color']}({child['pixels']})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
